explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares GPT-4 evaluator scores with human evaluation results across seven dimensions on 30 sampled dialogue groups, reporting both LLM and human scores side-by-side

prompts.notes: Specific prompts provided for S-IF goal relevance scoring and SOTOPIA-EVAL dialogue-level scoring in appendix sections

guidelines.notes: Human evaluators scored according to SOTOPIA-EVAL standards across seven predefined dimensions (BEL, REL, KNO, SEC, SOC, FIN, GOAL)

sample_size.notes: Used random seed=42 to sample 30 dialogue groups from the 450 SOTOPIA tasks for validation

quantitative_scores.notes: Human evaluations indicate GPT-4 as an evaluator tends to give inflated scores compared to human judgments

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4 evaluator consistently gives inflated scores across all seven evaluation dimensions compared to human judgments, with this tendency aligning with conclusions from prior work SOTOPIA-π

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluates additional S-IF metrics (S_div and S_rel) beyond the seven dimensions shared with human evaluation
